title: Merge Ordered Chains
description: Given two singly linked chains whose values are sorted in non-decreasing order, merge them into one sorted chain.
constraints: 1 <= n,m <= 100000; values are sorted in non-decreasing order; -10^9 <= values <= 10^9.
inputFormat: First line: n and m. Second line: n values of the first chain. Third line: m values of the second chain.
outputFormat: Print the merged sorted chain separated by spaces.
hints: Compare the current nodes of both chains and attach the smaller one.

examples.explanation: The two sorted chains are merged while preserving sorted order.
Equal values are retained from both chains.
